name: ci

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 26
      - name: Test cloud publisher
        run: node --test scripts/publish-cloud.test.mjs
      - name: Test documentation build
        run: node --test scripts/build-docs-site.test.mjs
      - name: Build documentation
        run: node scripts/build-docs-site.mjs

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true

      - name: Lint
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@ba0d7d2ec06a0ea1cb5fa41b2e4a3ab91d21278a # v9.3.0
        with:
          version: v2.14.0

      - name: Install analyzers
        run: |
          go install mvdan.cc/gofumpt@v0.12.0

      - name: Vet
        run: go vet ./...

      - name: Staticcheck
        run: go tool staticcheck ./...

      - name: Deadcode
        run: |
          output_file=$(mktemp)
          go tool deadcode -test ./... > "$output_file"
          if [ -s "$output_file" ]; then
            cat "$output_file"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Gofumpt
        run: |
          changed="$("$(go env GOPATH)/bin/gofumpt" -l .)"
          if [ -n "$changed" ]; then
            printf 'gofumpt wants changes in:\n%s\n' "$changed"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Gosec
        run: |
          go tool gosec -exclude=G101,G115,G202,G301,G304 ./...

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true

      - name: Test private checkpoint transport
        run: |
          python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_private_discord_checkpoint*.py'
          go test -count=1 scripts/private_checkpoint_publication_test.go scripts/private_checkpoint_workflow_test.go scripts/discord_report_workflow_test.go

      - name: Test source reconciliation entry point
        run: go test -count=1 scripts/reconcile_cloud_source.go scripts/reconcile_cloud_source_test.go

      - name: Test with race detector and coverage
        run: go test -count=1 -race ./... -coverprofile=coverage.out

      - name: Exclude generated code from coverage
        run: grep -v '^github.com/openclaw/discrawl/internal/store/storedb/' coverage.out > coverage.filtered.out

      - name: Enforce coverage floor
        run: |
          total="$(go tool cover -func=coverage.filtered.out | awk '/^total:/ { sub(/%$/, "", $3); print $3 }')"
          awk -v total="$total" 'BEGIN {
            if (total == "") {
              print "missing coverage total"
              exit 1
            }
            if (total + 0 < 85.0) {
              printf("coverage %.1f%% is below 85%%\n", total + 0)
              exit 1
            }
            printf("coverage %.1f%%\n", total + 0)
          }'

      - name: Build
        run: go build -o bin/discrawl ./cmd/discrawl

      - name: Smoke test CLI control surface
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$(./bin/discrawl help)"
          printf '%s\n' "$output"
          printf '%s' "$output" | grep -q "metadata"
          printf '%s' "$output" | grep -q "tui"
          test -n "$(./bin/discrawl --version)"
          ./bin/discrawl metadata --json | grep -q '"schema_version"'
          ./bin/discrawl status --json | grep -q '"databases"'
          ./bin/discrawl tui --json | grep -q '^\['

  native-smoke:
    env:
      MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: '13.0'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [xcode-27, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true
      - name: Test entrypoint and configuration
        run: go test -count=1 ./cmd/discrawl ./internal/config
      - name: Build and run native CLI
        shell: bash
        env:
          BINARY: bin/discrawl${{ runner.os == 'Windows' && '.exe' || '' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          go build -o "$BINARY" ./cmd/discrawl
          "$BINARY" --version
          "$BINARY" metadata --json > metadata.json
          grep -q '"schema_version"' metadata.json
          "$BINARY" help tui > tui-help.txt
          grep -q 'Usage: discrawl tui' tui-help.txt
      - name: Verify macOS deployment target
        if: ${{ runner.os == 'macOS' }}
        run: |
          test "$(xcrun vtool -show-build bin/discrawl | awk '$1 == "minos" { print $2 }')" = 13.0

  deps:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true

      - name: Verify module cache
        run: go mod verify

      - name: Check go.mod tidy
        run: |
          go mod tidy
          git diff --exit-code -- go.mod go.sum

      - name: Run govulncheck
        run: go tool govulncheck ./...

  release-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true

      - name: Snapshot release build
        uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@a4f02ab5355a589de60d917a659ce617ed19b3de # v7.3.0
        with:
          distribution: goreleaser
          version: v2.18.2
          args: release --snapshot --clean --skip=publish

  kiwi-helper:
    env:
      MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: '13.0'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os:
          - ubuntu-latest
          - xcode-27
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: tools/discrawl-kiwi/go.mod
          cache-dependency-path: tools/discrawl-kiwi/go.sum

      - name: Install Kiwi 0.24.0
        working-directory: tools/discrawl-kiwi
        run: bash install-kiwi.sh

      - name: Test Go binding helper
        working-directory: tools/discrawl-kiwi
        run: go test -count=1 ./...

  secrets:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true

      - name: Install gitleaks
        run: go install github.com/zricethezav/gitleaks/v8@v8.30.1

      - name: Scan git history
        run: |
          "$(go env GOPATH)/bin/gitleaks" git --no-banner --redact

      - name: Scan working tree
        run: |
          "$(go env GOPATH)/bin/gitleaks" dir . --no-banner --redact

  ja-helper:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: tools/discrawl-ja/go.mod
          cache-dependency-path: tools/discrawl-ja/go.sum
      - name: Test Japanese helper
        working-directory: tools/discrawl-ja
        run: go test -count=1 ./...

  zh-helper:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: tools/discrawl-zh/go.mod
          cache-dependency-path: tools/discrawl-zh/go.sum
      - name: Test Chinese helper
        working-directory: tools/discrawl-zh
        run: go test -count=1 ./...

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

version=v0.24.0
case "$(uname -s)" in
  Darwin) platform=mac ;;
  Linux) platform=lnx ;;
  *) echo "unsupported Kiwi build platform: $(uname -s)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
case "$(uname -m)" in
  arm64|aarch64)
    if [[ "$(uname -s)" == Linux ]]; then
      architecture=aarch64
    else
      architecture=arm64
    fi
    ;;
  x86_64|amd64) architecture=x86_64 ;;
  *) echo "unsupported Kiwi architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

archive="kiwi_${platform}_${architecture}_${version}.tgz"
url="https://github.com/bab2min/Kiwi/releases/download/${version}/${archive}"
work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

curl --fail --location "$url" --output "$work/kiwi.tgz"
case "$archive" in
  kiwi_lnx_aarch64_v0.24.0.tgz) expected_sha256=431fafce1bafc7bf5a4abcf7d306321df47cb4daabb9e8e16d40bb528a432fac ;;
  kiwi_lnx_x86_64_v0.24.0.tgz) expected_sha256=577768800258154da5fe6665081c73dafd6a0c39c8e091325d2b2bef8b5fb5d8 ;;
  kiwi_mac_arm64_v0.24.0.tgz) expected_sha256=87eda17f319c371824d5a2cc2e497eda6327ba3ddbf08a018db967f61ddbe48d ;;
  kiwi_mac_x86_64_v0.24.0.tgz) expected_sha256=98d64a1fd7acd409bb4b26889fa67355ed569e8be3568f731c3f3e27eb45a5f6 ;;
  *) echo "missing pinned Kiwi checksum for $archive" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
actual_sha256="$(shasum -a 256 "$work/kiwi.tgz" | awk '{print $1}')"
if [[ "$actual_sha256" != "$expected_sha256" ]]; then
  echo "Kiwi archive checksum mismatch for $archive" >&2
  exit 1
fi
tar -xzf "$work/kiwi.tgz" -C "$work"
sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/include /usr/local/lib
sudo cp -R "$work/include/kiwi" /usr/local/include/
sudo cp -P "$work"/lib/libkiwi* /usr/local/lib/
if [[ "$(uname -s)" == Linux ]]; then
  sudo ldconfig
fi

name: publish-discord-backup

on:
  schedule:
    # The daily member refresh replaces the ordinary 06:43 run.
    - cron: "43 0,2,4,8,10,12,14,16,18,20,22 * * *"
    - cron: "17 6 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: Current refresh or selected historical backfill
        type: choice
        options:
          - current
          - historical
        default: current
        required: true
      since:
        description: UTC midnight; current defaults to yesterday (<48h), historical requires explicit date (<31 days)
        type: string
        required: false

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: discord-backup-repo
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  DISCRAWL_NO_AUTO_UPDATE: "1"
  POLICY_COMMIT: "246adcd42b9a18d0f574daeda38a9a599fecd747"
  POLICY_SHA256: "1906b49215932b465986e5aa35bc1eeec3a2f5efbd6f63fcd930832cd30fc81f"

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 125
    steps:
      - name: Checkout discrawl
        timeout-minutes: 2
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Go
        timeout-minutes: 5
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true

      - name: Build native entry point
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: |
          go build -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/discrawl-native" ./cmd/discrawl

      - name: Configure runtime paths
        timeout-minutes: 1
        run: |
          umask 077
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/discrawl"
          echo "CONFIG=$RUNNER_TEMP/discrawl/config.toml" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "DB=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.discrawl-ci/discrawl.db" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "BACKUP_REPO=$RUNNER_TEMP/discord-backup" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "CHECKPOINT_RECEIPT=$RUNNER_TEMP/discrawl/checkpoint.json" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "ACQUISITION_POLICY=$RUNNER_TEMP/discrawl/report-selectors.json" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Verify pinned private acquisition policy
        timeout-minutes: 2
        id: policy
        env:
          DISCORD_BACKUP_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DISCORD_BACKUP_TOKEN }}
          DISCRAWL_BACKUP_REPOSITORY: ${{ secrets.DISCRAWL_BACKUP_REPOSITORY }}
          DISCRAWL_GUILD_ID: ${{ secrets.DISCRAWL_GUILD_ID }}
          HISTORY_SINCE: ${{ inputs.since }}
          HISTORY_MODE: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.mode || 'current' }}
        run: |
          python3 scripts/private_discord_checkpoint.py policy --policy "$ACQUISITION_POLICY" \
            --policy-commit "$POLICY_COMMIT" --policy-sha256 "$POLICY_SHA256" \
            --since "$HISTORY_SINCE" --acquisition-mode "$HISTORY_MODE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Restore verified private checkpoint
        timeout-minutes: 10
        id: restore
        env:
          DISCORD_BACKUP_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DISCORD_BACKUP_TOKEN }}
          DISCRAWL_BACKUP_REPOSITORY: ${{ secrets.DISCRAWL_BACKUP_REPOSITORY }}
        run: |
          umask 077
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$CONFIG")"
          python3 scripts/private_discord_checkpoint.py restore --prune --db "$DB" --receipt "$CHECKPOINT_RECEIPT"

      - name: Sync native Discord state
        timeout-minutes: 22
        id: sync
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN }}
          DISCRAWL_GUILD_ID: ${{ secrets.DISCRAWL_GUILD_ID }}
          HISTORY_SINCE: ${{ steps.policy.outputs.since }}
          HISTORY_MODE: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.mode || 'current' }}
          WITH_MEMBERS: ${{ github.event_name == 'schedule' && github.event.schedule == '17 6 * * *' }}
        run: |
          umask 077
          test -n "$DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN" && test -n "$DISCRAWL_GUILD_ID"
          python3 scripts/private_discord_checkpoint.py run --timeout 60 -- \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/discrawl-native" --config "$CONFIG" init --db "$DB" --guild "$DISCRAWL_GUILD_ID"
          member_flags=()
          if [ "$WITH_MEMBERS" = "true" ]; then
            member_flags+=(--with-members)
          fi
          python3 scripts/private_discord_checkpoint.py acquire --timeout 1200 \
            --writer-receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/discrawl/sync.json" \
            --native "$RUNNER_TEMP/discrawl-native" --config "$CONFIG" \
            --policy "$ACQUISITION_POLICY" --policy-sha256 "$POLICY_SHA256" --since "$HISTORY_SINCE" \
            --acquisition-mode "$HISTORY_MODE" "${member_flags[@]}"

      - name: Verify private ingestion checkpoint
        timeout-minutes: 15
        id: checkpoint
        if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() && steps.restore.outcome == 'success' && steps.sync.outcome != 'skipped' }}
        env:
          DISCORD_BACKUP_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DISCORD_BACKUP_TOKEN }}
          DISCRAWL_BACKUP_REPOSITORY: ${{ secrets.DISCRAWL_BACKUP_REPOSITORY }}
        run: |
          python3 scripts/private_discord_checkpoint.py save --timeout 840 --db "$DB" --receipt "$CHECKPOINT_RECEIPT" \
            --writer-receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/discrawl/sync.json"

      - name: Require successful native ingestion
        timeout-minutes: 1
        if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() && steps.sync.outcome != 'success' }}
        run: |
          echo "::error::Native ingestion did not complete. Publication was not requested; check the private checkpoint step for retained progress."
          exit 1

      - name: Publish Discord archive
        timeout-minutes: 10
        id: git-publish
        if: ${{ success() && steps.checkpoint.outcome == 'success' }}
        env:
          DISCORD_BACKUP_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DISCORD_BACKUP_TOKEN }}
          DISCRAWL_BACKUP_REPOSITORY: ${{ secrets.DISCRAWL_BACKUP_REPOSITORY }}
        run: |
          umask 077
          GIT_CREDENTIALS="$RUNNER_TEMP/discord-backup-git-credentials"
          printf 'https://x-access-token:[REDACTED]' "$DISCORD_BACKUP_TOKEN" > "$GIT_CREDENTIALS"
          git config --global credential.helper "store --file=$GIT_CREDENTIALS"
          git config --global user.name "discrawl publisher"
          git config --global user.email "discrawl-publisher@users.noreply.github.com"
          trap 'rm -f "$GIT_CREDENTIALS"' EXIT
          trap 'echo "::error::Private archive publication failed."; exit 1' ERR
          BACKUP_REMOTE="https://github.com/${DISCRAWL_BACKUP_REPOSITORY}.git"
          git clone --depth=1 --single-branch --branch main --no-tags -- "$BACKUP_REMOTE" "$BACKUP_REPO" >/dev/null 2>&1
          git -C "$BACKUP_REPO" config --add remote.origin.fetch '^refs/tags/*' >/dev/null 2>&1
          DISCRAWL_PRODUCER_REPOSITORY="$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
          DISCRAWL_PRODUCER_REVISION="$GITHUB_SHA" \
          DISCRAWL_PRODUCER_RUN_ID="$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
          DISCRAWL_PRODUCER_RUN_ATTEMPT="$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" \
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/discrawl-native" --config "$CONFIG" publish \
            --repo "$BACKUP_REPO" --remote "$BACKUP_REMOTE" --readme "$BACKUP_REPO/README.md" \
            --message "sync: discord archive" --push >/dev/null 2>&1
          echo "published=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Archive publication completed."

name: discord-backup-report

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 7 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: discord-backup-repo
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  DISCRAWL_NO_AUTO_UPDATE: "1"

jobs:
  report:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - name: Checkout discrawl
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true

      - name: Build native reporter
        run: go build -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/discrawl-native" ./cmd/discrawl

      - name: Generate daily Discord report
        env:
          DISCORD_BACKUP_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DISCORD_BACKUP_TOKEN }}
          DISCRAWL_BACKUP_REPOSITORY: ${{ secrets.DISCRAWL_BACKUP_REPOSITORY }}
          CONFIG: ${{ runner.temp }}/discrawl/config.toml
          DB: ${{ github.workspace }}/.discrawl-ci/discrawl.db
          BACKUP_REPO: ${{ runner.temp }}/discord-backup
          CHECKPOINT_RECEIPT: ${{ runner.temp }}/discrawl/checkpoint.json
        run: |
          umask 077
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$CONFIG")"
          python3 scripts/private_discord_checkpoint.py restore --db "$DB" --receipt "$CHECKPOINT_RECEIPT"
          GIT_CREDENTIALS="$RUNNER_TEMP/discord-backup-git-credentials"
          printf 'https://x-access-token:[REDACTED]' "$DISCORD_BACKUP_TOKEN" > "$GIT_CREDENTIALS"
          git config --global credential.helper "store --file=$GIT_CREDENTIALS"
          git config --global user.name "discrawl reporter"
          git config --global user.email "discrawl-reporter@users.noreply.github.com"
          trap 'rm -f "$GIT_CREDENTIALS"' EXIT
          trap 'echo "::error::Private archive report failed."; exit 1' ERR
          BACKUP_REMOTE="https://github.com/${DISCRAWL_BACKUP_REPOSITORY}.git"
          git clone --depth=1 --single-branch --branch main --no-tags -- "$BACKUP_REMOTE" "$BACKUP_REPO" >/dev/null 2>&1
          git -C "$BACKUP_REPO" config --add remote.origin.fetch '^refs/tags/*' >/dev/null 2>&1
          if python3 scripts/private_discord_checkpoint.py report-check --receipt "$CHECKPOINT_RECEIPT" --archive "$BACKUP_REPO"; then
            :
          else
            result=$?
            if [ "$result" = "3" ]; then
              echo "::notice::Report skipped: current checkpoint has not been published to the archive."
              exit 0
            fi
            exit "$result"
          fi
          printf 'db_path = "%s"\n' "$DB" > "$CONFIG"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/discrawl-native" --config "$CONFIG" report --published --field-notes --readme "$BACKUP_REPO/README.md" >/dev/null 2>&1
          report_paths=(README.md reports/latest-field-notes.md reports/latest-field-notes.json)
          git -C "$BACKUP_REPO" add -- "${report_paths[@]}" >/dev/null 2>&1
          if git -C "$BACKUP_REPO" diff --cached --quiet -- "${report_paths[@]}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Report and field notes already up to date"
            exit 0
          fi
          git -C "$BACKUP_REPO" commit --only -m "docs: update discord activity report and field notes" -- "${report_paths[@]}" >/dev/null 2>&1
          git -C "$BACKUP_REPO" push >/dev/null 2>&1
          echo "Archive report completed."

# discrawl-ja

Optional Japanese lexical helper. It uses the pure-Go
[`github.com/ikawaha/kagome/v2`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/ikawaha/kagome/v2)
tokenizer in Search mode with the embedded MeCab-IPADIC dictionary.

This binary is not linked into the default Discrawl release. Build it only when
Japanese lexical fields are enabled.

```bash
go build -o discrawl-ja .
```

The helper speaks the same newline-delimited JSON protocol as `discrawl-kiwi`.

Query requests add `"query":true` to the JSON request. The response includes
`"groups":[["surface","base"],["required-term"]]`: groups are conjoined,
while equivalent terms within one group are alternatives. Index requests

# discrawl-zh

Optional Chinese lexical helper. It uses the pure-Go
[`github.com/go-ego/gse`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/go-ego/gse)
search-mode segmenter with the embedded default dictionary.

This binary is not linked into the default Discrawl release. Build it only when
Chinese lexical fields are enabled.

```bash
go build -o discrawl-zh .
```

The helper speaks the same newline-delimited JSON protocol as `discrawl-kiwi`.

Query requests add `"query":true` to the JSON request. The response includes
`"groups":[["surface","base"],["required-term"]]`: groups are conjoined,
while equivalent terms within one group are alternatives. Index requests
continue to return the flat `tokens` string. Build helpers from the same
Discrawl source revision as the CLI.

func TestHistoryPermissionDenialExportsUnavailableAndRecovers(t *testing.T) {
	for _, concurrency := range []int{1, 2} {
		for _, denyAt := range []int{1, 2} {
			t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("workers-%d/check-%d", concurrency, denyAt), func(t *testing.T) {
				ctx := t.Context()
				db, err := store.Open(ctx, filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "archive.db"))
				require.NoError(t, err)
				t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, db.Close()) })
				require.NoError(t, db.UpsertGuild(ctx, store.GuildRecord{ID: "g1", RawJSON: `{}`}))
				require.NoError(t, db.UpsertChannel(ctx, store.ChannelRecord{ID: "c1", GuildID: "g1", Kind: "text", RawJSON: `{}`}))
				channel := &discordgo.Channel{ID: "c1", GuildID: "g1", Type: discordgo.ChannelTypeGuildText}
				client := &windowPermissionClient{fakeClient: &fakeClient{messages: map[string][]*discordgo.Message{}}}
				svc := New(client, db, nil)
				since := time.Now().UTC().Add(-time.Hour)
				opts := SyncOptions{Full: true, Since: since, Concurrency: concurrency}
				run := func() {
					t.Helper()
					_, err := svc.syncMessageChannels(ctx, "g1", []*discordgo.Channel{channel}, opts)
					require.NoError(t, err)
				}
				run()
				scope := channelHistoryWindowScope("c1", since)
				previous, err := db.GetSyncState(ctx, scope)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				var proof HistoryWindow
				require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(previous), &proof))
				require.Equal(t, since, proof.Since)

				client.denyAt = client.calls + denyAt
				run()
				unavailable, err := db.GetSyncState(ctx, channelMessageUnavailableScope("c1"))
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Equal(t, "missing_history_permissions", unavailable)
				retained, err := db.GetSyncState(ctx, scope)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Equal(t, previous, retained)
				complete, err := db.GetSyncState(ctx, channelHistoryCompleteScope("c1"))
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Empty(t, complete)

				repo := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "snapshot")
				_, err = share.Export(ctx, db, share.Options{RepoPath: repo})
				require.NoError(t, err)
				imported, err := store.Open(ctx, filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "imported.db"))
				require.NoError(t, err)
				t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, imported.Close()) })
				_, err = share.Import(ctx, imported, share.Options{RepoPath: repo})
				require.NoError(t, err)
				for key, want := range map[string]string{scope: previous, channelMessageUnavailableScope("c1"): unavailable} {
					got, err := imported.GetSyncState(ctx, key)
					require.NoError(t, err)
					require.Equal(t, want, got)
				}

				client.denyAt = 0
				calls := client.calls
				run()
				require.Equal(t, calls+2, client.calls, "full retry must bypass the fresh unavailable marker")
				unavailable, err = db.GetSyncState(ctx, channelMessageUnavailableScope("c1"))
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Empty(t, unavailable)
				recovered, err := db.GetSyncState(ctx, scope)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.NotEqual(t, previous, recovered, "successful recovery must refresh the same window")
			})
		}
	}
}

func TestHistoryPermissionCheckErrorIsNotDenial(t *testing.T) {
	for _, checkErr := range []error{errors.New("channel identity changed before history permission check"), errors.New("required history permissions are denied"), context.DeadlineExceeded} {
		t.Run(checkErr.Error(), func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx := t.Context()
			db, err := store.Open(ctx, filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "archive.db"))
			require.NoError(t, err)
			t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, db.Close()) })
			client := &windowPermissionClient{fakeClient: &fakeClient{}, permissionErr: checkErr}
			svc := New(client, db, nil)
			channel := &discordgo.Channel{ID: "c1", GuildID: "g1", Type: discordgo.ChannelTypeGuildText}
			_, err = svc.syncWindowChannelHistory(ctx, channel, channelSyncState{}, false, time.Now().Add(-time.Hour), nil)
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, checkErr)
			require.Empty(t, unavailableReason(err), "an unproven check is not a permission denial")
		})
	}
}

func TestHistoryPermissionMarkerWriteFailureIsFatal(t *testing.T) {
	for _, concurrency := range []int{1, 2} {
		t.Run(strconv.Itoa(concurrency), func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx := t.Context()
			db, err := store.Open(ctx, filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "archive.db"))
			require.NoError(t, err)
			t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, db.Close()) })
			channel := &discordgo.Channel{ID: "c1", GuildID: "g1", Type: discordgo.ChannelTypeGuildText}
			client := &windowPermissionClient{fakeClient: &fakeClient{messages: map[string][]*discordgo.Message{}}}
			var logs bytes.Buffer
			svc := New(client, db, slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(&logs, nil)))
			since := time.Now().UTC().Add(-time.Hour)
			opts := SyncOptions{Full: true, Since: since, Concurrency: concurrency}
			_, err = svc.syncMessageChannels(ctx, "g1", []*discordgo.Channel{channel}, opts)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			scope := channelHistoryWindowScope("c1", since)
			previous, err := db.GetSyncState(ctx, scope)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.NotEmpty(t, previous)
			_, err = db.DB().ExecContext(ctx, `create trigger reject_unavailable before insert on sync_state
                when new.scope = 'channel:c1:unavailable'
                begin select raise(abort, 'fixture marker write failure'); end`)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			client.denyAt = client.calls + 1
			_, err = svc.syncMessageChannels(ctx, "g1", []*discordgo.Channel{channel}, opts)
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, errHistoryPermissionDenied)
			require.Contains(t, logs.String(), "fixture marker write failure")
			retained, err := db.GetSyncState(ctx, scope)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, previous, retained)
			marker, err := db.GetSyncState(ctx, channelMessageUnavailableScope("c1"))
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Empty(t, marker)
		})
	}
}

# discrawl-kiwi

`discrawl-kiwi` is Discrawl's optional Korean lexical analyzer helper. It uses
the existing [`github.com/codingpot/kiwigo`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/codingpot/kiwigo)
Go binding and Kiwi's public C API. It does not use Python.

## Native prerequisites

- Kiwi 0.24.0 headers and dynamic library
- Kiwi 0.24.0 base model
- a C/C++ toolchain supported by CGO

The `kiwigo` build currently looks for headers and libraries under
`/usr/local/include` and `/usr/local/lib`. The official Kiwi release assets are:

- `kiwi_<platform>_<architecture>_v0.24.0.tgz`
- `kiwi_model_v0.24.0_base.tgz`

Build:

```bash
bash install-kiwi.sh
go build -o discrawl-kiwi .
```

Run:

```bash
discrawl-kiwi --model /path/to/models/cong/base
```

The helper speaks newline-delimited JSON over stdin/stdout and stays alive so
the model is loaded once:

```text
{"ready":true,"version":"0.24.0"}
{"text":"오늘 저녁먹음 기록"}
{"tokens":"오늘 저녁 먹 음 기록"}
```

## License boundary

Kiwi 0.24.0 is licensed under Apache-2.0; the unchanged
`github.com/codingpot/kiwigo` binding remains LGPL-2.1. Discrawl invokes this separately distributed helper as an
optional process, and the helper dynamically links to the replaceable Kiwi
library. Distributors of the helper or Kiwi binary assets must include the
applicable license notices and satisfy the binding's LGPL source requirements.

Query requests add `"query":true` to the JSON request. The response includes
`"groups":[["surface","base"],["required-term"]]`: groups are conjoined,
while equivalent terms within one group are alternatives. Index requests
continue to return the flat `tokens` string. Build helpers from the same
Discrawl source revision as the CLI.

# Discrawl

Mirror Discord guilds into local SQLite. Search server history without depending on Discord search. Bring a bot token, or read everything offline from a Git snapshot.

## What it does

- discovers every guild a bot can access and syncs channels, threads, members, and message history into SQLite
- maintains FTS5 indexes for fast literal search; optional embeddings for semantic and hybrid recall
- imports classifiable Discord Desktop cache messages with `wiretap`, including proven DMs under `@me`
- downloads attachment media into the local cache and includes cached non-DM media as gzip-compressed Git snapshot files
- tails the Gateway for live updates with periodic repair sweeps
- publishes the archive as sharded NDJSON snapshots in a private Git repo so readers can search offline with no Discord credentials
- exposes read-only SQL, channel/member directories, mention queries, digests, and trend analytics

## Pick your path

- **New here?** Read [Install](install.html) and run `discrawl init`.
- **Already have a bot?** Jump to [`sync`](commands/sync.html) and [`search`](commands/search.html).
- **Just want to read a shared archive?** Use [`subscribe`](commands/subscribe.html) for Git snapshots, or [`subscribe-cloud`](commands/subscribe-cloud.html) for a Worker-fronted archive - no Discord token needed.
- **Need DM search?** [`wiretap`](commands/wiretap.html) imports local Discord Desktop cache.
- **Need multilingual lexical search?** Configure [language analyzers](guides/search-modes.html) and run [`lexical rebuild`](commands/lexical.html).
- **Want semantic search?** Configure [Embeddings](guides/embeddings.html), then run [`embed`](commands/embed.html).
- **Need public server-size history without a bot?** [`metrics`](commands/metrics.html) records approximate membership and online presence in a separate database.
- **Wiring an agent or launcher?** `discrawl metadata --json`, `discrawl status --json`, `discrawl diagnostics --json`, `discrawl coverage --json`, `discrawl failures --json`, `discrawl remote status`, and `discrawl doctor --json` expose the read-only crawlkit control surface.

## At a glance

```bash
export DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN="..."
discrawl init
discrawl doctor
discrawl sync --full
discrawl search "panic: nil pointer"
discrawl tail
```

[`discrawl tui`](commands/tui.html) uses the shared crawlkit terminal explorer:
channel/person/thread groups on the left, message rows in the middle, and
readable message/thread detail on the right.

## Sections

- **[Start](install.html)** - install, configure, set up the Discord bot, security notes, release history, contact
- **[Guides](guides/)** - maintainer archive workflows, sync sources, wiretap internals, search modes, embeddings, Git snapshots, data layout
- **[Commands](commands/)** - one page per CLI command

## Where to file issues

`https://github.com/openclaw/discrawl/issues`. See [contact](contact.html) for project links.

type fixtureTransport func(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error)

func (f fixtureTransport) RoundTrip(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) { return f(r) }
func TestReconciliationEntryPointLoadsPrivatePlanAndUsesNativeDiscordClient(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	cfg := config.Default()
	cfg.DBPath = filepath.Join(dir, "runtime.db")
	configPath := filepath.Join(dir, "config.toml")
	require.NoError(t, config.Write(configPath, cfg))
	db, err := store.Open(context.Background(), cfg.DBPath)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, db.UpsertGuild(context.Background(), store.GuildRecord{ID: "1", Name: "fixture", RawJSON: `{}`}))
	require.NoError(t, db.Close())
	plan := syncer.ReconcilePlan{Archive: "fixture", Members: []syncer.ReconcileMember{{GuildID: "1", UserID: "3"}}}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(plan)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var compressed bytes.Buffer
	writer := gzip.NewWriter(&compressed)
	_, err = writer.Write(raw)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, writer.Close())
	t.Setenv("DISCRAWL_CLOUD_RECONCILE_PLAN", base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(compressed.Bytes()))
	t.Setenv("DISCRAWL_CLOUD_ARCHIVE", "fixture")
	t.Setenv("DISCRAWL_GUILD_ID", "1")
	t.Setenv("CONFIG", configPath)
	t.Setenv("DB", cfg.DBPath)
	t.Setenv("DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN", "fixture-bot-token")
	previous := http.DefaultTransport
	t.Cleanup(func() { http.DefaultTransport = previous })
	calls := 0
	http.DefaultTransport = fixtureTransport(func(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
		if req.Header.Get("Authorization") != "Bot fixture-bot-token" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unexpected fixture authorization")
		}
		calls++
		var body string
		switch {
		case strings.HasSuffix(req.URL.Path, "/guilds/1"):
			body = `{"id":"1"}`
		case strings.HasSuffix(req.URL.Path, "/guilds/1/members/3"):
			body = `{"user":{"id":"3","username":"fixture","bot":true},"roles":["7"],"joined_at":"2026-09-19T00:00:00Z"}`
		default:
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unexpected fixture request")
		}
		return &http.Response{StatusCode: 200, Header: http.Header{"Content-Type": []string{"application/json"}}, Body: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(body)), Request: req}, nil
	})
	require.NoError(t, run())
	require.Equal(t, 2, calls)
	db, err = store.Open(context.Background(), cfg.DBPath)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer func() { require.NoError(t, db.Close()) }()
	var count int
	require.NoError(t, db.DB().QueryRowContext(context.Background(), "select count(*) from members where guild_id='1' and user_id='3' and bot=1").Scan(&count))
	require.Equal(t, 1, count)
	t.Setenv("DISCRAWL_GUILD_ID", "other")
	require.Error(t, run())
	require.Equal(t, 2, calls)
	// No token is written to the config or source records.
	content, err := os.ReadFile(configPath)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotContains(t, string(content), "fixture-bot-token")
}
